title: metastelma guilleminianum
intro: Metastelma guilleminianum, commonly known as the Guinea vine or Madagascar Metastelma, is a flowering plant species found in Madagascar. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Metastelma guilleminianum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and analgesic properties. Bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
